# Design system

Every visual decision lives in one file: [`frontend/packages/ui-kit/src/theme/tokens.ts`](../frontend/packages/ui-kit/src/theme/tokens.ts). It is plain data. The MUI theme reads it directly, and
`scripts/generate` derives everything else from it (this page, and `DesignTokens.g.cs` for Identity's server-rendered sign-in pages).
A lint rule fails the build on a colour literal anywhere else, and CI fails if a derived file is out of date.

## Rules

- Use the theme (`theme.palette`, `sx` colour names, `theme.spacing`), never a value. Components in modules and the shell contain no colour, font size or radius literals.
- Status is never colour alone: a `StatusChip` always carries text.
- Body text and control edges meet WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for the edge of an input or other control.
- A tenant may change the primary colour and logo only. Nothing else about the design varies per tenant.
- Two elevations (raised, overlay), two densities (compact, comfortable), one font family.
